prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A1 prescribed display paths with independently selected binary coordinates; no path evolution or physical certification is implied.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0.35 is a non-endpoint display choice, not a derived response value.
The common binary midpoint, zero group translation, radii, decompositions, frequencies, phases, and circulation signs are illustrative coordinates permitted by A1.
Normalized linear axis interpolation is an illustrative path between the taxonomy-defined Family-A endpoints.
